verdict.rationale: A remote desktop product could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, such as session summaries or suggestions drawn from audit logs and device data, so this story applies to RustDesk. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions any AI-generated insights or suggestions. The documented features are remote control, file transfer, chat, session recording, audit logs, a web console and a management API, none of which provide AI analysis.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
